purpose: Nicotine polacrilex is used to help people quit smoking or using other tobacco products. It reduces cravings and withdrawal symptoms that make quitting so hard. It is part of a quit-smoking plan that may also include counseling or support programs.
how_it_works: When you chew the gum or let the lozenge dissolve in your mouth, it slowly releases a small, controlled amount of nicotine into your body through the lining of your mouth. This gives your body just enough nicotine to ease cravings and uncomfortable withdrawal feelings without the harmful chemicals found in cigarettes. Over time, you gradually use less and less until your body no longer needs nicotine at all.
common_side_effects: Mouth soreness, jaw aches, or irritation in the throat or mouth are common, especially with the gum. You may also notice hiccups, nausea, upset stomach, or heartburn. Some people get headaches or feel dizzy, particularly if they use too much.
warnings: Do not smoke, vape, or use any other tobacco or nicotine products while using this — getting too much nicotine can be dangerous. Tell your doctor if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have heart disease, high blood pressure, or a recent heart attack. Keep all nicotine products away from children and pets, as even small amounts can be very harmful to them. Stop use and talk to your doctor if you have irregular heartbeat, chest pain, or severe mouth or throat irritation.
typical_dosing: For the gum: chew it slowly until you feel a tingling sensation, then park it between your cheek and gum — repeat this process for about 30 minutes. Do not eat or drink 15 minutes before or during use. Most people start with one piece every 1 to 2 hours and follow a gradual step-down schedule over about 12 weeks. Your doctor or pharmacist can help you pick the right strength (2 mg or 4 mg) based on how heavily you smoked.
